Dorthe Svenstrup is a leading physician and PhD at Hospitalsenhed Midt, recognized for her central role in advancing the quality of care for patients with atrial fibrillation in Denmark [^src1]. She serves as a member of the [[afdk-styregruppe|Styregruppen for AFDK]], contributing to the interdisciplinary and cross-sectoral governance of the national quality development framework [^src1] [^src2]. 

In her clinical leadership, Svenstrup drives initiatives at the [[atrieflimren-klinik|Atrieflimren-klinik]] at Hospitalsenhed Midt [^src1]. She is specifically highlighted for implementing structured patient education, a core quality improvement effort designed to support patients and their relatives [^src1]. This educational focus has been a continuous priority since the interdisciplinary clinic was established in 2012 [^src1]. Her contributions reflect the broader national objectives detailed in the AFDK reports: ensuring uniform, evidence-based, and patient-centered care for a common and potentially serious chronic heart condition [^src1].
